artifact_rules.schema: Existing tool key/session/recovery format; preserved without record conversion
artifact_rules.purpose: Operator credentials, recovered outputs and necessary history
artifact_rules.retention: Preserve original recovery material and keys; no automatic deletion or queue replay
artifact_rules.restore: Restore the private companion to a separate directory; never overwrite original databases

path_validation: Canonical absolute paths; fleet_guards.runtime companion resolver; destinations inside this source tree refused; PRIVATE publication enforced by the commit-time .githooks, not at write time
